name: designcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for DesignCraft: lay out flyers, posters, brochures, menus, cards, certificates and book pages (text, images, shapes, tables, paragraph styles), data-merge CSVs, edit .designcraft / InDesign .idml files and export print-ready PDF (PDF/X-4), PNG, IDML, EPUB and HTML with DesignCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . designcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)
